preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the polygon n must be between 1 and 50 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Each row of the polygon matrix must have a length equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for row in matrix for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the polygon matrix must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(c == '1' for row in matrix for c in row) and all((row[i] == '1' and row[i+1] == '0') or (row[i] == '0' and row[i+1] == '1') for i in range(n-1) for row in matrix)
postconditions.description: If there is a '1' in the matrix, it must not be followed by another '1' in the same row or column.
